mode: Independent read-only review; isolated fixture tests; no public/shared edits.
result: No blocking introduced defect found in the catalogue safeguards. A legacy missing-clause display ambiguity was identified and the parent implemented the conservative renderer-only correction.
safeguards: Validator rejects excluded IDs reintroduced into public findings and checks each excluded coverage link carries its catalogue correction.
Exclusion overlays are applied after all research merges. Stale research cannot erase the dedicated reason/evidence or create finding links absent from the public catalogue.
The UI gives catalogueReview priority over older research conclusions and includes the correction evidence among its sources.
The test fixture first checks its valid baseline, then asserts the specific exclusion failure, and isolates the builder from ongoing research temporary files.
Completion still requires an explicit researcher reviewComplete:true marker; catalogue correction overlays do not grant completion.

verification.result: 2 tests passed in the independent run; no persistent fixture
verification.browser: Parent separately reports all 52 case pages and 675 selector combinations checked without errors; this reviewer did not independently repeat that browser run.

missingClauseRows.cause: The provisionChecks arrays are correctly keyed by changeId, but omit separate rows for the later LT/PT correction groups; six also omit a separate transposition row. Absence was previously rendered as an expressly pending comparison. The same 18 cells existed in the supplied baseline.
missingClauseRows.evidenceLimits: Some review scopes and existing clause evidence address the later correction context, including Lithuania’s corrected deadline. Other missing rows do not contain an explicit legal result. Neither completion nor non-applicability can be inferred from a missing row.

implementedRemedy.missingValue: No separate clause assessment is recorded; see the assessment scope and sources.

missingClauseRows.assessment: The renderer now faithfully distinguishes an unmapped separate row from a researcher’s explicit pending assessment, without inventing a satisfied duty or a completion verdict.
missingClauseRows.upstreamFollowup: Raw-bundle owner can separately enumerate correction applicability/results and transposition assessments where evidence supports them; no automatic substantive synthesis recommended.

irishSettlementFinality.result: The current Irish cell already has 27 explicit group rows, including four language-specific corrections marked not applicable, and no obsolete blocker. The supplied baseline had only 23 rows. No further remediation needed.

finalCataloguePass.result: Final titles, summaries, consequences and qualifications remain conservative overall. The revised French research-payment entry foregrounds binding alternative payment routes and limits the unresolved concern to legal alignment; no practical restriction or missing safeguard is asserted. No additional blocking claim inconsistency identified in this pass.
finalCataloguePass.substantiveLimit: This is a final consistency check informed by the completed primary-source and peer audits, not a fresh independent retrieval of every cited source.

limits: Exact-ID exclusion checks do not detect a semantically identical issue republished under a new ID; none was found in the current catalogue.
A researcher completion marker certifies scoped research; validation does not establish the legal truth or completeness of every clause.
Detailed evidence and representative missing-row cells are preserved in technical-safeguards-peer-24-46.json and coverage-clause-label-peer-24-46.json.
